files.role: pinned producer and per-case fresh-process replay runner
files.contents: Verifies frozen protocol, release binary, source index, and every candidate system before invoking the exact first-fall CLI. Writes one attempt.json per system and an aggregate producer summary.
Recomputes planned/attempted/completed/replayed/status counts and SHA-256 bindings from the per-case attempt records and saved certificates.

files.role: pre-data protocol, instrument, host, and source binding
files.contents: Protocol ID and freeze digest, binary digest, dataset-index digest, host metadata, three candidate IDs, and the declared 144-system scope.
One row per PDP system with candidate, family, m, target kind, original system byte count and SHA-256, and canonical input-row SHA-256.

files.role: raw per-case execution and replay record
files.contents: Exact command argv, return code, elapsed time, stdout/stderr, source hashes, certificate hash and fields, S3 certificate key, and fresh-process replay outcome. Failed and timed-out attempts are retained.
The source-bound polynomial presentation, explicit witness or certified lower bound, certificate fields, and original system SHA-256.
Counts and compact first-fall rows for the fixed 144-system cohort; it does not encode missing LFD as a value.
Counts and source/certificate/replay consistency recomputed by analyze_run.py.

The preflight, source index, raw case records, certificates, summaries, validation, run source, and this format document; original system inputs remain referenced by SHA-256 in the already-persisted content-addressed store.
Archive S3 key, byte count and SHA-256, per-certificate readback results, bundle readback result, and source input custody references.
